phases.title: Governance Foundation
phases.objective: Establish repository authority, security boundaries, CI, and deterministic project governance.
exit_criteria: Exact governed candidate passes blocking GitHub Actions lanes and is revalidated on main.

phases.title: Local Capability Executor
phases.objective: Implement bounded local filesystem, process, Git, policy, and approval-aware execution primitives.
exit_criteria: Structured capability tests pass cross-platform and raw shell remains default-denied.

phases.title: Authenticated Remote Relay
phases.objective: Add outbound-only relay command/result routing with bounded queues and sessions.
exit_criteria: Cross-platform relay tests pass and no inbound PC listener is required.

phases.title: Pairing, Trusted Approval, and Identity
phases.objective: Bind persistent device/controller identities, replay protection, session generations, local approvals, and audit.
exit_criteria: Exact Phase 3 work SHA and identical main SHA pass Linux, Windows, macOS, race, and governance.

phases.title: Runnable Agent and Terminal Chat
phases.objective: Integrate runnable outbound agent, controller bridge, provider-neutral chat loop, and terminal max-chat.
exit_criteria: Exact Phase 4 work SHA and identical main SHA pass all five blocking lanes.

phases.title: Protocol & Durability
phases.objective: Persist restart-critical relay state and publish protocol-v1 signing/restart compatibility vectors without weakening session binding.
exit_criteria: Encrypted durability, restart/replay semantics, protocol vectors, exact work acceptance, and main revalidation pass.

phases.title: Transport V2
phases.objective: Add outbound WebSocket command delivery with reconnect, heartbeat, bounded backoff, session refresh, FIFO lease safety, and long-poll fallback while preserving protocol-v1 authority.
exit_criteria: Linux, Windows, macOS, race, and latest Skill_Workflow governance pass on the exact final work SHA.
Identical final P6 SHA is revalidated on main.
No inbound PC listener or transport-level privilege authority is introduced.

phases.title: Cloudflare Relay
phases.objective: Add a protocol-v1-conformant Cloudflare Worker + per-device SQLite Durable Object relay with Hibernation WebSocket agent connectivity, durable controller/result routing, and measured Free-plan resource behavior.
exit_criteria: TypeScript Cloudflare adapter passes the accepted protocol-v1 signing and restart fixtures without weakening device, generation, expiry, replay, or agent-session binding.
SQLite Durable Object tests prove restart/hibernation-safe trust, queue, result, and replay semantics with bearer sessions remaining short-lived.
Hibernation WebSocket tests preserve outbound-only agent connectivity and stale-session rejection.
A deployed Cloudflare staging environment passes paired command/result E2E without opening an inbound PC port.
Free-plan request, CPU, storage, and connection budgets are measured and documented.
Exact final P7 work SHA and identical-SHA main revalidation pass all blocking lanes under current Skill_Workflow.

phases.title: MCP Gateway
phases.objective: Expose the existing structured capability protocol through an MCP adapter.
exit_criteria: Discovery and calls map only to declared capabilities; unknown and unrestricted shell calls fail closed.

phases.title: Multi-client Compatibility
phases.objective: Validate one backend contract across ChatGPT-compatible, Codex/IDE, and generic MCP clients.
exit_criteria: Shared conformance suite passes without client-specific protocol forks.

phases.title: Device & Permission Model
phases.objective: Add multi-device naming, selection, revocation, scopes, and per-device policy.
exit_criteria: Device isolation, revocation, and scope regressions pass.

phases.title: Desktop Agent UX
phases.objective: Add desktop/tray pairing, status, approval, and audit experience while keeping privilege authority local.
exit_criteria: Normal operation no longer requires terminal interaction and approval boundaries remain local.

phases.title: Web Dashboard
phases.objective: Add device, session, audit, and revocation administration UI.
exit_criteria: Dashboard management cannot bypass agent policy and management E2E tests pass.

phases.title: ChatGPT Integration
phases.objective: Package the MCP-backed integration for the supported ChatGPT app/plugin surface without coupling the core to OpenAI-specific behavior.
exit_criteria: ChatGPT to MCP to relay to agent to result E2E is proven on a supported surface.

phases.title: Extended Capabilities
phases.objective: Expand bounded filesystem, Git, process, app, and optional screen/GUI capabilities.
exit_criteria: Every capability has explicit schema, bounds, policy, approval class, audit shape, and adversarial tests.

phases.title: Security Hardening
phases.objective: Refresh threat model and run fuzzing, injection, replay, downgrade, secret, and dependency reviews.
exit_criteria: No unresolved release-blocking security findings remain.

phases.title: Packaging
phases.objective: Provide Windows, Linux, and macOS installers, service integration, protected key storage, and update strategy.
exit_criteria: Fresh-machine install, uninstall, service lifecycle, and protected-key behavior pass on all supported OS families.

phases.title: Scale & Reliability
phases.objective: Prove load, reconnect/offline behavior, retention, recovery, and Cloudflare/self-hosted resource budgets.
exit_criteria: Published limits and repeatable reliability/load suites pass for both deployment modes.

phases.title: Physical E2E
phases.objective: Validate real internet, real devices, relay modes, MCP clients, restart/recovery, and approval flows.
exit_criteria: Physical production-matrix evidence passes on supported devices and deployment modes.

phases.title: Public Release
phases.objective: Finalize onboarding, release artifacts, security process, documentation, and versioned public release.
exit_criteria: v1.0.0 artifacts and final main validation pass.
